source: YAS Travel and Subsistence Policy v7.1 (March 2022, extension to Sep 2025)
notes: LLM-generated from policy-text.txt, spot-check a sample against the PDF before trusting blind.

questions.question: What's the mileage rate for using my own car on Trust business?
My home-to-base one-way distance is 30 miles. I drove 80 miles total today doing work journeys. How many miles can I claim?
I'm attending a 1-day training course. Can the Trust book me overnight accommodation?
questions.expected: Not normally — accommodation is not usually provided for 1-day events. An exception may apply if the course has an early start time and your travel from home would exceed 1 hour.

questions.question: My home is 45 minutes from a training venue. Am I eligible for overnight accommodation?
questions.expected: No. Distance from home to venue must exceed 1 hour as determined by AA route planner or HERE Maps.

questions.question: I forgot to submit an expense from 5 months ago. Can I still claim it?
questions.expected: No, unless you have been on long-term sick leave. Claims must be submitted within 3 months / 90 days of expenditure.

questions.question: I need to travel to a conference in Germany. Who has to approve it?
questions.expected: A Director must authorise overseas travel in advance.

questions.question: Can a colleague with signatory authority approve my expense claim if my line manager is on leave?
questions.expected: No. Claims must be authorised by a manager with authorised signatory approval, not by colleagues.

questions.question: I drove a colleague to a meeting. Do I get anything extra on top of the mileage rate?
questions.expected: Yes, a passenger supplement of 5p per mile.

questions.question: The Trust offered me overnight accommodation for a course but I chose to drive in each day. Can I claim travel time?
questions.expected: No, unless there is good reason such as carer responsibilities.

questions.question: I bought lunch while attending a meeting away from base but lost the receipt. Can I claim it back?
questions.expected: No. Meal claims will only be paid on production of appropriate receipts.
